twcm_editor_recruit = {
    scope = character
    is_shown = { is_ai = no }
    is_valid = { is_ai = no custom_tooltip = { text = twcm_ui_finish_review NOT = { has_variable = twcm_ui_pending } } custom_tooltip = { text = twcm_ui_select_living has_variable = twcm_ui_target exists = var:twcm_ui_target var:twcm_ui_target ?= { is_alive = yes } } custom_tooltip = { text = twcm_editor_recruit_requirements root.var:twcm_ui_target = { is_alive = yes } root.var:twcm_ui_other = { is_alive = yes } NOT = { root.var:twcm_ui_target = root.var:twcm_ui_other } root.var:twcm_ui_target = { is_landed = yes } root.var:twcm_ui_other = { is_landed = no is_ruler = no is_imprisoned = no NOT = { is_courtier_of = root.var:twcm_ui_target } } } }
    effect = { remove_variable = twcm_ui_pending_title
remove_variable = twcm_ui_pending_ruler
twcm_ui_prepare_effect = yes
set_variable = { name = twcm_ui_pending value = 27 }
set_variable = { name = twcm_ui_pending_revision value = 10601 }
set_variable = { name = twcm_ui_pending_target value = var:twcm_ui_target }
set_variable = { name = twcm_ui_pending_other value = var:twcm_ui_other }
if = { limit = { has_variable = twcm_ui_claim_title exists = var:twcm_ui_claim_title } set_variable = { name = twcm_ui_pending_title value = var:twcm_ui_claim_title } }
if = { limit = { has_variable = twcm_ui_claim_ruler exists = var:twcm_ui_claim_ruler } set_variable = { name = twcm_ui_pending_ruler value = var:twcm_ui_claim_ruler } }
remove_variable = twcm_ui_pending_editor_title
if = { limit = { has_variable = twcm_editor_title } set_variable = { name = twcm_ui_pending_editor_title value = var:twcm_editor_title } }
remove_variable = twcm_ui_pending_editor_title_owner
if = { limit = { has_variable = twcm_editor_title_owner } set_variable = { name = twcm_ui_pending_editor_title_owner value = var:twcm_editor_title_owner } }
remove_variable = twcm_ui_pending_editor_war
if = { limit = { has_variable = twcm_editor_war } set_variable = { name = twcm_ui_pending_editor_war value = var:twcm_editor_war } }
remove_variable = twcm_ui_pending_editor_artifact
if = { limit = { has_variable = twcm_editor_artifact } set_variable = { name = twcm_ui_pending_editor_artifact value = var:twcm_editor_artifact } }
remove_variable = twcm_ui_pending_editor_culture
if = { limit = { has_variable = twcm_editor_culture } set_variable = { name = twcm_ui_pending_editor_culture value = var:twcm_editor_culture } }
remove_variable = twcm_ui_pending_editor_faith
if = { limit = { has_variable = twcm_editor_faith } set_variable = { name = twcm_ui_pending_editor_faith value = var:twcm_editor_faith } }
remove_variable = twcm_ui_pending_editor_rite
if = { limit = { has_variable = twcm_editor_rite } set_variable = { name = twcm_ui_pending_editor_rite value = var:twcm_editor_rite } }
remove_variable = twcm_ui_pending_editor_other_culture
